vadsrijk.klassen.spec.schildridder.kort: Steady combos with your pillow sword. Catch hits on your Cuddle Shield, then strike back hard. Want to tank? The Tank branch sits right next to it in your skill tree.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_spec_schildridd: You chose Shield Knight at your first job advancement.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.reuzenkussen.kort: Slow, huge sweeps that also hit everything around your target, and leaps that shake the ground. A club or fluff hammer feels extra good here.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_spec_reuzenkuss: You chose Giant Pillow at your first job advancement.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.scherpschutter.kor: Long range and critical hits. Your arrows curve to the target, far shots hit harder, and your Cuddle Arrow becomes a charged shot.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_spec_scherpschu: You chose Sharpshooter at your first job advancement.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.strikkenzetter.kor: Quick shots, snares and fluff traps. You hold foes in place, make them sticky and wear them down over time. Strong against groups. Want to help your group? The Support branch sits next to it.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_spec_strikkenze: You chose Trapper at your first job advancement.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.sterrenwever.kort: Elemental bursts: your Fireball leaves a puddle, every third spell is free, and later the ice shatters and the ground burns.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_spec_sterrenwev: You chose Starweaver at your first job advancement.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.zegenzanger.rol: Songs that hurt foes and help friends
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.zegenzanger.kort: You sing while you fight: your song makes you and your group stronger, and every 2 s a song pulse hits every foe around you. Want to heal? The Heal branch sits next to it.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_spec_zegenzange: You chose Blessing Singer at your first job advancement.
Your shield is your best friend.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.schildridder: Double Smack: Pillow Smack swings again (60 %). Counter: catch a hit with your Cuddle Shield and your next Pillow Smack within 4 s does 50 % more.
Crystal Wall: while your Cuddle Shield is up, every foe that hits you freezes for 3 s. Pillow Smack does 40 % more to frozen foes.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.kort.schildridder.2: Crystal Wall: shield freezes, +40 % vs frozen
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.schildridder: Bulwark Flop: Vahoege Flop does 30 % more and stuns everything it hits for 2 s. Pillow Smack does 15 % more.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.reuzenkussen: Giant Sweep: your basic hits do 30 % more and also hit foes within 3 blocks of your target (50 %). Pillow Smack does 60 % more but recharges 1 s slower.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.kort.reuzenkussen.1: Giant Sweep: swings that hit everything
The ground shakes when you land.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.reuzenkussen: Pillow Roll: Storm Leap does 60 % more, is ready 2 s sooner and stuns what it hits for 1 s.
Nest Form: Vahoege Flop does 30 % more and its wind pulls every foe within 8 blocks to the middle. Basic hits 10 % harder still.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.onder.scherpschutte: One eye closed, one shot home.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.scherpschutt: Falcon Gaze: your arrows curve a little to the target, +8 % crit chance and +15 % crit damage. Far shots: basic shots at foes further than 10 blocks do 30 % more.
Charged Arrow: your Cuddle Arrow does 80 % more damage to foes.
Crown Falcon: Star Shot does 40 % more plus a quarter again as true damage, right through shields. Basic shots 8 % harder.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.strikkenzett: Somersault Volley: mid-roll you fire 3 arrows at the nearest foe. Snare: where you roll away, a trap stays for 6 s: whoever steps in sticks for 3 s and is Tracked (4 s of damage). Quick bow: 8 % attack speed.
Ice Star: every 5th basic shot that hits fires an ice star along (1x weapon damage, freezes 2 s). Star Shot freezes everything it pierces for 4 s.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.onder.strikkenzette: The whole field is your trap.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.strikkenzett: Snare Rain: where Star Shot lands, a snare field lies for 5 s (radius 4): 40 % damage and Sticky every second. 8 % more attack speed.
The stars dance to your beat.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.sterrenwever: Your Pink Fireball leaves an element puddle for 3 s. Vads Overflow: every 3rd skill gives its energy back; +10 % cooldown reduction and +8 % element damage.
Ice that sings as it breaks.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.sterrenwever: Mirror Echo: your Fireball freezes for 1.5 s; when it hits a foe that was already frozen, the ice shatters (1.2x damage, radius 3).
Where you cast, the ground glows.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.uitleg.sterrenwever: Twilight Sage: Meteor Guh leaves a pink fire field for 5 s (30 % damage + Burning every second). 8 % more element damage.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.kort.sterrenwever.3: Ult: fire field after Meteor Guh
Battle Song: you do 15 % more damage, your group within 10 blocks 8 % more. In a fight a song pulse hits every foe within 6 blocks every 2 s (50 % weapon damage).
Song Circle: your Vads Spring sings along: for 6 s every foe inside takes 40 % weapon damage each second.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.kort.zegenzanger.2: Song Circle: Vads Spring hurts foes
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.onder.zegenzanger.3: The final chord of the realm.
Final Chord: Meteor Guh does 30 % more and gives your group 8 s of Vahoeg (+20 % damage).

vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_adv1.uitleg: Earned in the ceremony at class level 17.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_adv1.uitleg: Earned in the ceremony at class level 17.

vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_adv2.uitleg: Earned in the ceremony at class level 35.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_adv2.uitleg: Earned in the ceremony at class level 35.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_adv2.uitleg: Earned in the ceremony at class level 35.

vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_adv3.uitleg: Earned in the ceremony at class level 58.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_adv3.uitleg: Earned in the ceremony at class level 58.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.klaar1: ✦ Your %s is level 17! Go to Grootmeester Vadsvoet in Zwamzoet to choose your specialisation.
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.klaar2: ✦ Your %s is level 35! In zone 3 Ordemeester Wasja waits for you in the Nest Chapel (after the Cheese Zeppelin Yard).
vadsrijk.klassen.adv.klaar3: ✦ Your %s is level 58! After Mother Wolkwal's lullaby, Captain Veerkracht waits for you in Hoogvads.
vadsrijk.klassen.tak.stam.uitleg: For everyone of this class, whatever specialisation you choose.
vadsrijk.klassen.tak.zij.knuffelridder.u: Optional: get tougher and protect your group.
vadsrijk.klassen.tak.zij.pluisjager.uitl: Optional: help your group with healing arrows, small shields and marks.
vadsrijk.klassen.tak.dicht_nog: First choose your specialisation (class level 17, with the Grootmeester).
vadsrijk.klassen.tak.dicht_ander: This is the other specialisation. You can switch in any town at the class master.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_vaste_hand.uitl: More crit chance and faster swings.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_schildmeester.u: Defence, Strength and crit in one.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_schildmuur.uitl: Lots of Defence and harder crits.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_onbreekbaar.uit: Every hit you catch on your Cuddle Shield makes Pillow Smack ready 1 s sooner.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_reuzenkracht.ui: Lots of Strength and extra Vads.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_reuzenplof.uitl: After Storm Leap your next Pillow Smack (within 4 s) does 60 % more damage.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.r_paladijnsaura.u: Every 2 s you and your group within 10 blocks heal 1.5 % of their Vads.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_sluipschutter.u: More crit chance and much harder crits.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_strikkenweb.uit: Your basic shots do 25 % more damage to Sticky foes.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.j_zorgzaam.uitleg: More Healing Power and extra Vads.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_sterrenvonk.uit: More Element Damage and some Wisdom.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_koorkracht.uitl: Lots of Wisdom and extra Vads.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_slotlied.uitleg: Your Battle Song gives you 5 % more damage and the song pulse reaches 2 blocks further.
vadsrijk.klassen.knoop.m_warme_handen.ui: More Healing Power and some Vads.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.onderkop: %s: two paths. Switch in any town at the class master (once per 10 minutes).
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.onderkop.kies: %s: choose your path! Both deal good damage, also solo.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.word.tip: Your first job advancement: a new title, a new power and your own branch in the skill tree.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.wissel.tip: Free. Your points in the old spec branch come back. Then wait 10 minutes.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.later.tip: You choose your specialisation with Grootmeester Vadsvoet in Zwamzoet when your class is level 17.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.knop.tip: See both specialisations of this class, or switch (once per 10 minutes, not in a fight).
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.gewisseld: ✦ You are now %s! Your points from the old branch are back.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.migratie: ✦ The classes were renewed! Your skill tree was re-laid: all your points are back (free). Your job advancements were moved to the new model. Have a look with K.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.kies_nog: ✦ Your %s may still choose a specialisation! Press K and click 'Choose your specialisation'.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.nee.al: You already have a specialisation. Switch at the class master.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.nee.nog_niet: You choose your specialisation with Grootmeester Vadsvoet, at class level 17.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.nee.balie: You can only switch in a town, at the class master.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.nee.gevecht: Not in the middle of a fight! Wait until it is calm.
vadsrijk.klassen.spec.nee.arena: Not in a boss arena or dungeon.
vadsrijk.klassen.respec.klaar: Your skill tree is empty and your points are back. Choose again! (Resetting is always free.)
vadsrijk.klassen.scherm.ordetempel: You are always all three classes: attack with another weapon to switch. Reset (always free) and switch your specialisation at the class master in any town.
vadsrijk.klassen.scherm.respec.tip: All your points in this class back. Always free. Your specialisation and advancements stay.
vadsrijk.klassen.scherm.adv.dicht: From level %s, through the class quest.
vadsrijk.klassen.tip.adv: Your class is ready for a job advancement! Check your quest log for the class master who is waiting for you.
